results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE reputation > 100000;
SELECT AVG(view_count) AS avg_view_count FROM posts_questions;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS negative_score_answers FROM posts_answers WHERE score < 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_comments FROM comments;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) AS distinct_tags_used FROM post_tags;
SELECT MAX(score) AS highest_question_score FROM posts_questions;

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM posts_questions q JOIN post_tags pt ON q.post_id = pt.post_id JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name ORDER BY question_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT u.user_id, u.display_name, SUM(a.score) AS total_answer_score FROM posts_answers a JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name ORDER BY total_answer_score DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(c.cnt, 0)), 3) AS avg_comments_per_question
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.post_id = q.post_id
JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments GROUP BY post_id) c ON c.post_id = q.post_id
WHERE t.tag_name = 'javascript';

SELECT u.user_id, u.display_name, c.comment_count
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count
  FROM comments
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id
  ORDER BY comment_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
) c
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id
ORDER BY c.comment_count DESC;

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM posts_questions q JOIN post_tags pt ON q.post_id = pt.post_id JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id WHERE q.score >= 10 GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name ORDER BY question_count DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS question_count, AVG(q.view_count) AS avg_view_count FROM tags t JOIN post_tags pt ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_view_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM posts_questions q JOIN users u ON q.user_id = u.user_id WHERE strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) = strftime('%Y', u.creation_date);

SELECT u.user_id, u.display_name, COUNT(*) AS accepted_answers
FROM posts_answers a
JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE a.is_accepted = 1
AND a.parent_id IN (
SELECT pt.post_id
FROM post_tags pt
JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
WHERE t.tag_name = 'javascript'
)
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY accepted_answers DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_without_questions FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts_questions q WHERE q.user_id = u.user_id);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS answers_without_comments FROM posts_answers a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = a.post_id);

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unaccepted_count, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS unaccepted_share
FROM tags t
JOIN post_tags pt ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
ORDER BY unaccepted_share DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer_count FROM posts_answers a WHERE a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts_questions q WHERE q.user_id = a.user_id);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_with_zero_badges FROM users WHERE badge_count = 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM posts_questions WHERE creation_date >= '2021-03-01' AND creation_date < '2021-04-01';

SELECT strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS questions_with_answers, ROUND(AVG((julianday(fa.first_answer_date) - julianday(q.creation_date)) * 24), 2) AS avg_hours_to_first_answer
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN (SELECT parent_id, MIN(creation_date) AS first_answer_date FROM posts_answers GROUP BY parent_id) fa ON fa.parent_id = q.post_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) IN ('2020', '2021')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', q.creation_date)
ORDER BY year;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fa.first_answer IS NOT NULL AND julianday(fa.first_answer) - julianday(q.creation_date) <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_answered_within_24h FROM posts_questions q LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent_id, MIN(creation_date) AS first_answer FROM posts_answers GROUP BY parent_id) fa ON fa.parent_id = q.post_id;
SELECT strftime('%m', creation_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM posts_questions GROUP BY strftime('%m', creation_date) ORDER BY question_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT strftime('%Y', creation_date) AS join_year, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY join_year ORDER BY join_year;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS weekend_question_count FROM posts_questions WHERE strftime('%w', creation_date) IN ('0', '6');
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_answers, SUM(is_accepted) AS accepted_answers, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(is_accepted) / COUNT(*), 4) AS acceptance_rate FROM posts_answers WHERE strftime('%Y', creation_date) = '2021';
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.score > q.score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_answers_higher_than_question FROM posts_answers a JOIN posts_questions q ON a.parent_id = q.post_id;

SELECT CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 'first_answer' ELSE 'later_answers' END AS answer_type,
       COUNT(*) AS answer_count,
       ROUND(AVG(score), 3) AS avg_score
FROM (
    SELECT post_id, parent_id, score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY creation_date, post_id) AS rn
    FROM posts_answers
) ranked
GROUP BY CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 'first_answer' ELSE 'later_answers' END;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS python_questions, SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_accepted_answer, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS accepted_fraction FROM posts_questions q JOIN post_tags pt ON q.post_id = pt.post_id JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id WHERE t.tag_name = 'python';

SELECT AVG(acceptance_rate) AS avg_acceptance_rate FROM (SELECT user_id, 1.0 * SUM(is_accepted) / COUNT(*) AS acceptance_rate FROM posts_answers WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10);
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type = 3 OR LOWER(CAST(vote_type AS TEXT)) IN ('3','downmod','downvote','down') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS downvote_percentage FROM votes;

SELECT yr, user_id, display_name, answer_count
FROM (
  SELECT c.yr, c.user_id, u.display_name, c.answer_count,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.yr ORDER BY c.answer_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y', creation_date) AS yr, user_id, COUNT(*) AS answer_count
    FROM posts_answers
    WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY yr, user_id
  ) c
  JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id
)
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY yr;

WITH top_tags AS (
  SELECT tag_id, COUNT(*) AS total_questions
  FROM post_tags
  GROUP BY tag_id
  ORDER BY total_questions DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT pt.tag_id, strftime('%Y-%m', q.creation_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS question_count
  FROM post_tags pt
  JOIN top_tags tt ON tt.tag_id = pt.tag_id
  JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
  GROUP BY pt.tag_id, strftime('%Y-%m', q.creation_date)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT tag_id, month, question_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tag_id ORDER BY question_count DESC, month) AS rn
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT t.tag_name, tt.total_questions, r.month, r.question_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN top_tags tt ON tt.tag_id = r.tag_id
JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = r.tag_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY tt.total_questions DESC;

SELECT month, monthly_answers, SUM(monthly_answers) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_answers FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', creation_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS monthly_answers FROM posts_answers GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', creation_date)) ORDER BY month;

SELECT q.post_id, q.title, a.answer_count_actual, a.max_score, a.min_score, (a.max_score - a.min_score) AS score_gap
FROM (
  SELECT parent_id, COUNT(*) AS answer_count_actual, MAX(score) AS max_score, MIN(score) AS min_score
  FROM posts_answers
  GROUP BY parent_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
) a
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = a.parent_id
ORDER BY score_gap DESC
LIMIT 10;

ORDER BY accepted_answers DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_without_questions FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts_questions q WHERE q.user_id = u.user_id);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS answers_without_comments FROM posts_answers a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = a.post_id);

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unaccepted_count, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS unaccepted_share
FROM tags t
JOIN post_tags pt ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
ORDER BY unaccepted_share DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer_count FROM posts_answers a WHERE a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts_questions q WHERE q.user_id = a.user_id);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_with_zero_badges FROM users WHERE badge_count = 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM posts_questions WHERE creation_date >= '2021-03-01' AND creation_date < '2021-04-01';

SELECT strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS questions_with_answers,
       ROUND(AVG((julianday(fa.first_answer_date) - julianday(q.creation_date)) * 24.0), 2) AS avg_hours_to_first_answer
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN (
    SELECT parent_id, MIN(creation_date) AS first_answer_date
    FROM posts_answers
    GROUP BY parent_id
) fa ON fa.parent_id = q.post_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) IN ('2020', '2021')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', q.creation_date)
ORDER BY year;
SELECT strftime('%m', creation_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM posts_questions GROUP BY strftime('%m', creation_date) ORDER BY question_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT strftime('%Y', creation_date) AS join_year, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY join_year ORDER BY join_year;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS weekend_question_count FROM posts_questions WHERE strftime('%w', creation_date) IN ('0', '6');
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_answers, SUM(is_accepted) AS accepted_answers, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(is_accepted) / COUNT(*), 4) AS acceptance_rate FROM posts_answers WHERE strftime('%Y', creation_date) = '2021';
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.score > q.score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_answers_higher_than_question FROM posts_answers a JOIN posts_questions q ON a.parent_id = q.post_id;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT parent_id, score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY creation_date, post_id) AS rn
  FROM posts_answers
)
SELECT CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 'first_answer' ELSE 'later_answer' END AS answer_type,
       COUNT(*) AS answer_count,
       ROUND(AVG(score), 3) AS avg_score
FROM ranked
GROUP BY answer_type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS python_questions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_accepted_answer,
       ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS fraction_accepted
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN post_tags pt ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
WHERE t.tag_name = 'python';

SELECT AVG(acceptance_rate) AS avg_acceptance_rate FROM (SELECT user_id, 1.0 * SUM(is_accepted) / COUNT(*) AS acceptance_rate FROM posts_answers WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10);
SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN lower(CAST(vote_type AS TEXT)) IN ('3','downmod','downvote','down') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS downvote_share FROM votes;

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y', creation_date) AS year, user_id, COUNT(*) AS answer_count
  FROM posts_answers
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y', creation_date), user_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT year, user_id, answer_count,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY answer_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT r.year, r.user_id, u.display_name, r.answer_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id
WHERE r.rnk = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

WITH top_tags AS (
  SELECT tag_id, COUNT(*) AS total_questions
  FROM post_tags
  GROUP BY tag_id
  ORDER BY total_questions DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT pt.tag_id, strftime('%Y-%m', q.creation_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS question_count
  FROM post_tags pt
  JOIN top_tags tt ON tt.tag_id = pt.tag_id
  JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
  GROUP BY pt.tag_id, strftime('%Y-%m', q.creation_date)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT tag_id, month, question_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tag_id ORDER BY question_count DESC, month) AS rn
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT t.tag_name, tt.total_questions, r.month, r.question_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN top_tags tt ON tt.tag_id = r.tag_id
JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = r.tag_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY tt.total_questions DESC;

SELECT month, monthly_answers, SUM(monthly_answers) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_answers FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', creation_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS monthly_answers FROM posts_answers GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', creation_date)) ORDER BY month;

SELECT q.post_id, q.title, a.answer_count_actual, a.max_score, a.min_score, (a.max_score - a.min_score) AS score_gap
FROM (
  SELECT parent_id, COUNT(*) AS answer_count_actual, MAX(score) AS max_score, MIN(score) AS min_score
  FROM posts_answers
  GROUP BY parent_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
) a
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = a.parent_id
ORDER BY score_gap DESC
LIMIT 10;
